notes: Four local Green profiles inside the Cornerman Tier-3 LOCAL WORKER LANE (not a 'weak helper'; not global CVL tiers). Green Code = local code worker for contained C#/Razor/SCSS candidate patches; Green Deep = distiller + architecture warmer; Green Daily = report/audit worker; Green Fast = triage clerk. Tier-3 is cheap + untrusted: good for real work and code candidates, but NOT final authority — VENGEANCE compiles/proves and Bloodwave approves commits. Verify exact model keys on Cornerman with `lms ls --llm --detailed` before relying on them. See CORNERMAN_MODEL_ROUTING.md.

untrustedMeans: Good for real work, code candidates, reports, and prep

roles.Qwen 27B / Deep: local distiller and architecture warmer (Green Deep)
roles.Qwen Daily / MoE: faster report and audit worker (Green Daily)

routingLaw.ruleOfThumb: Qwen Coder can cook contained code. Green Deep warms the kitchen. Grok finds the ingredients. Opus owns the risky recipe. Bloodwave approves the meal.

catalog.role: Green Deep — local distiller + architecture warmer: long repo/canon distill, DECISION-vs-code comparison, Opus/Grok packet prep, scope-risk review. NOT for fast triage; NOT final authority on money/persistence/[Sync]/migration/commit.
Green Daily (default) — report/audit worker: recurring prep, comparisons, audits, structured Markdown, inbox/outbox, Red handoffs, daily long runs. NOT deep authority decisions.
Green Fast — triage clerk: quick file location, short summaries, routing checks, fast task classification. NOT important implementation.

Green Code — local code worker: contained C#/Razor/SCSS candidate patches, refactors, read-only view models, patch-ready diff proposals. VENGEANCE applies/recreates + compiles + proves in s&box; Bloodwave approves commit. NOT final authority on economy, persistence, [Sync(FromHost)], purchase routing, or commits.
RAG embeddings — paired with daily or deep when needed
